ne9cf416e96.summary: Hungary's central bank is considering adding climate risk scenarios to its policy framework, Deputy Governor Zoltan Kurali said. He warned that drought and a likely rebound in global food prices could push up inflation next year.

n49954c4ea1.headline: India’s exports under free trade pacts grew faster than imports in April-July: Piyush Goyal
n49954c4ea1.summary: Piyush Goyal says India's exports under free trade pacts grew 23.9% from April to July, faster than imports, indicating better use of trade agreements.

n1d7ca6ec81.summary: Oil jumped to $105 a barrel amid signs the Iran war will not be resolved quickly. Gas prices and borrowing costs also surged as fears of Middle East escalation grew.

n021e9a94cb.headline: A second war in the Middle East, and a second vital world waterway is about to be blocked
n021e9a94cb.summary: Iran-backed Houthi rebels have taken control of the historic Yemeni port city of Mocha, according to four military sources. The article describes a second vital world waterway at risk of being blocked.
n021e9a94cb.why: Mocha sits on the Red Sea, and disruption in Red Sea and Bab el-Mandeb transit routes affects global shipping, freight rates and energy flows.

n4ab21ee7c9.headline: MEPs push to finance Ukraine defence through Russian frozen assets
n4ab21ee7c9.summary: A letter signed by 122 EU lawmakers calls to reopen debate on using frozen Russian assets to finance Ukraine's defence amid a budget crunch.
n4ab21ee7c9.why: The use of frozen assets for defence financing has significant geopolitical and economic implications for EU and Ukraine budgets.

neebb963381.headline: Saga Metals Corp.: SAGA Metals Reports Assays from R-0064 to R-0071 with Intercepts Including 52.52% Fe2O3, 7.58% TiO2, 0.428% V2O5 from 2026 Drilling at Radar Critical Minerals Project in Labrador
neebb963381.summary: SAGA Metals Corp. reported assay results including 52.52% Fe2O3, 7.58% TiO2, and 0.428% V2O5 from 2026 drilling at its Radar Critical Minerals Project in Labrador.
neebb963381.why: High-grade assay results can enhance the value of mineral projects and attract investment in mining companies.
